raw_response:
I am 54, never went to school, but I have farmed this land for 35 years. My hands know what to do. Let me think about this year.

I have 12 mu. Wheat-maize rotation on most of it, like everyone here in Quzhou. Cotton on a small piece because the price was decent last year and my husband says we should keep some. I will put 4 mu in cotton, and the other 8 mu does wheat in winter then maize in summer — two harvests from the same ground, that is how we make a living on small land.

For wheat: I plant in October. I buy the seed from the same dealer in town, the improved kind everyone uses now — Jimai something, I forget the number but the bag is the one with red writing. I use about 15 kg seed per mu, maybe a bit more because cold can kill some. Before planting I spread two bags of compound fertilizer (50 kg bags, the 15-15-15 kind) per mu, that is 100 kg. Then in spring when wheat turns green I put one bag of urea per mu, 25 kg. My neighbor Old Wang puts less but his wheat is yellow in May, I do not want that. Better to spend a little more than have thin wheat. I water at planting, then green-up in spring, then at heading, then once when grain is filling — four times if the rain does not come. I spray for aphids once, sometimes twice if I see them bad. I plough before planting, the tractor man comes and does it for 60 yuan a mu. I expect about 450 kg per mu, last year was 470 but the year before only 400 because of dry spring.

For maize: After wheat harvest in June I plant maize right away, no time to waste. Hybrid seed, Zhengdan or Xianyu, the dealer tells me which is good this year. About 2 kg seed per mu, I plant with the seeder. I put one bag of compound fertilizer at planting, 50 kg, and then when maize is knee-high I top-dress with urea, about 30 kg per mu. Some people put more but maize on this ground gives me 550 kg with this much. I water two times if no rain — at jointing and at tasseling. Spray once for borers. No ploughing because wheat stubble is there, I just use rotary tiller, faster. Expect 550 kg per mu.

For cotton: Cotton is more trouble. I plant in late April. I use improved seed with the Bt for bollworm, the dealer says it saves spraying. About 1.5 kg seed per mu. Cotton needs more fertilizer — I put two bags of compound at planting (100 kg) and then urea 20 kg when buds form, and another 15 kg at flowering. Cotton needs water — I irrigate four or five times. Even with Bt seed I still spray three or four times for aphids and other bugs, cotton always has bugs. I plough before planting. I hope for 250 kg seed cotton per mu, that is what I usually get.
